Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Bologna hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 29, 2026 snapshot, at 15 of the 18 Bologna hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Vio.com at 5, Agoda at 3, Super.com at 2, Traveluro at 2, Evendo at 1, Priceline at 1 and the hotel's own site at 1. These are the Bologna rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

On this page, all-in: with taxes and fees as the sites reported them (a resort or destination fee may be extra), at 15 of the 17 hotels listed below a site was 5% or more below the all-in going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Etrip.net at 5, Vio.com at 5, Agoda at 3, goseek.com at 2, Super.com at 2, Traveluro at 2, Amimir.com at 1, Booking.com at 1 and 2 other sites at 2 between them (a tie counts for each site). At the other 2, no site was 5% or more below it. The two counts differ: the study also counts the 1 named below that are not listed on this page. Each hotel below shows every site's all-in price. Taxes and fees at Bologna hotels

At the 12 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 20% ($28 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 8% at Residence le Porte to 46% at Hotel Panorama. At 5 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
